layout: 2-step flow. Light bg. Step indicator at top. Back arrow top-left. Desktop: sidebar with buddy mini-profile remains visible.
elements: STEP INDICATOR: '1 of 2' or '2 of 2' with progress bar
Mini calendar showing current month. Available dates highlighted with green dot (#22C55E). Selected date highlighted orange (#FF8A34). Tap to select
Below calendar: Scrollable list of time slot cards. Each card: time range (e.g. 07:00-08:00), duration '1 hour', price 'Rp XX'. Selected slot has orange border + checkmark
Summary card: Buddy photo (small), name, date, time, gym location (address), package type (single/package)
Price breakdown: subtotal, promo discount (if any), total (bold, navy, large)
Promo code: Expandable input field + 'Apply' button
Waiver note: small text 'By confirming, you agree to TrialFit's cancellation policy'
CTA: 'Confirm Booking' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, large
SIDEBAR (desktop only): Buddy mini-profile — photo, name, tier badge, rating
notes: Keep it simple and guided. One step at a time. Promo code is expandable (don't show by default). CTA is always visible at bottom.
